text: ロケットだんに　たかく　うりつけて　やるぜ　……そ　そんなに　にらむなよ！

structure.jp: ロケットだんに　たかく　うりつけて　やるぜ
structure.en: I'm going to sell it to Team Rocket for a high price

structure.jp: ……そ　そんなに　にらむなよ！

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb can show rough determination to do something, often something nasty. うりつけて　やる = 'I'm going to go and sell it'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a blunt 'don't'. にらむな = 'don't glare'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. やるぜ = 'I will, you bet'.
